# GreenLearning

> GreenLearning provides free, hands-on environmental education programs and challenges for Canadian K-12 students, connecting climate action, renewable energy, and sustainability to real-world impact.

GreenLearning is Canada's leading environmental education organization offering integrated STEAM programs aligned with UN Sustainable Development Goals. The platform combines curriculum-based learning with student competitions and challenges that engage youth in climate resilience, renewable energy, circular economy, and indigenous environmental stewardship.

## Key Topics

- Environmental Education
- Climate Action
- Renewable Energy
- Sustainability

## Core Programs

- [Climate Policy Quest](https://programs.greenlearning.ca/climate-policy-quest): High school climate policy education program aligned with UN SDGs and indigenous perspectives
- [Energy Revealed](https://programs.greenlearning.ca/energy-revealed): Energy efficiency K-12 program with metering tools and sustainability challenges
- [Re-Energy](https://programs.greenlearning.ca/re-energy): Renewable energy STEAM program covering solar, wind, hydro for grades 3-12
- [Eco 360](https://programs.greenlearning.ca/eco-360): Plastic waste and circular economy education program for grades 3-12 aligned with SDGs
- [Flood:ED](https://programs.greenlearning.ca/flooded): Climate resilience program teaching flood mitigation and watershed management
- [Electrifying the Future](https://programs.greenlearning.ca/electrifying-the-future-etf): Electric vehicle conversion STEM program for high school students in Calgary and Alberta
- [The Ripple Effect](https://programs.greenlearning.ca/the-ripple-effect): Bilingual ocean protection and blue economy program for Canadian youth
- [Sila and the Land](https://programs.greenlearning.ca/sila-and-the-land): Indigenous teachings and environmental stewardship children's book program

## Student Challenges & Competitions

- [Challenges Hub](https://greenlearning.ca/challenges): Hub page for GreenLearning's educational challenges in energy, sustainability, and climate
- [Take the Energy Revealed Challenge](https://programs.greenlearning.ca/take-the-energy-revealed-challenge): Challenge submission page for Energy Revealed electricity tracking competition
- [Take the Eco 360 Challenge](https://programs.greenlearning.ca/take-the-eco-360-challenge): Challenge submission page for Eco 360 plastic waste solution competition
- [Take the Re-Energy Challenge 2025](https://programs.greenlearning.ca/take-the-re-energy-challenge-2025): 2025 renewable energy challenge submission for solar, wind, hydro projects
- [Take the Flood:ED Challenge](https://programs.greenlearning.ca/take-the-flooded-challenge): Challenge submission page for Flood:ED climate resilience competition
- [Submission Showcase 2025](https://programs.greenlearning.ca/submission-showcase2025): 2024-2025 school year student project showcase and challenge results
